differential_against_the_ordinary_chain.compared: plan basis, the accession numbers of every admitted filing, and the selected block indices - not 'it produced something'
differential_against_the_ordinary_chain.the_one_that_does_not: JPMorgan fails at period selection with SAVED_HISTORY_INCOHERENT, which every historical route shares and which is in the acquisition plan. It is not this route's.

the_one_not_caught.why: the form set and the role assignment guard the same thing, so removing either alone leaves the other answering and nothing observable changes. The pair is what is load-bearing, which GIVE_D02_THE_PROXY_ROLES_TOO removes both halves to show.

measured_before_writing_it.result: nine of ten companies resolve through CURRENT_SAME_CIK_DEF14A and Paramount through SAME_PERIOD_PART_III_ANNUAL_AMENDMENT, whose governance information is in the 10-K/A that adds Part III rather than in a proxy. Both levels are wired.
measured_before_writing_it.why: the same discipline B06 and C03 needed. A metric whose ordinary chain is a cascade cannot be ported one level at a time without giving the companies on the other levels the first level's answer.

the_difference_the_comparison_found.how_it_was_found: Paramount is the only company where the two rules differ, and the comparison asserts statuses rather than only values.
the_difference_the_comparison_found.what: the historical route set PREPARED_ORIGINAL_WITH_AMENDMENTS whenever the period carried an annual amendment; the frozen route sets it for D02 only.
the_difference_the_comparison_found.why_the_frozen_rule_is_right: at C02's second level the annual amendment IS the source, so calling the input 'original with amendments' describes the same document twice.

measured.and_both_stop_there: SAVED_SOURCE_MISSING with the document's URL. Ten proxies are saved of the 82 the submissions indexes list and all ten were filed in 2026, so an earlier period is a source gap - which is the answer, not a route gap.

the_one_rule_that_is_replaced.the_frozen_rule: every proxy filed on or after the period end, ordered newest first, take the first - that is the newest of them.
the_one_rule_that_is_replaced.why_it_is_right_for_the_current_period: only one annual meeting has been held since the current period ended, so newest and earliest are the same filing. The ordinary chain is correct and this is not a defect in it.
the_one_rule_that_is_replaced.why_it_is_wrong_for_a_pinned_earlier_per: for Marriott's 2023 year the filter admits the 2024, 2025 and 2026 proxies and the newest is the 2026 one. The annual meeting that reports on a year is the one held after it ends, so the successor takes the earliest at or after the pinned end.

what_is_not_done.content_acceptance: a frozen Run and a public row say the route selected something and bound its bytes. Nobody has read the 29 excerpts against the proxy.
what_is_not_done.earlier_periods: every period but the newest names its proxy and stops. Wiring and delivery are two things and this is the first.
what_is_not_done.the_proxy_amendment_branch: this repository holds no DEF 14A/A at all, so the amendment rule is carried unexercised. For an earlier period it can reach a later year's proxy amendment and the plan then refuses with a named implementation gap rather than answering.

what_this_is: C02 for a pinned annual period. It is the last route this repository's saved material can reach without a model call, and it was previously recorded as blocked on model allowance, which was wrong: C02 runs through the same deterministic excerpt machinery as D02.
